_note: Extracted from the painting guide. Per faction: id, abbreviation, name, subtitle, category, colors {base|trim|accent: {name, hex}} or null for a short profile, description, subunits (differing formations, optional), paintSequence (a Citadel recipe, optional), tip (the pitfall, optional), profile (true = a text card only, the scheme is still open).

categories.name: Inner Sphere
categories.description: The five Successor States, plus ComStar and the lesser powers. If you want a classic start, this is the safest bet.

categories.name: Clans
categories.description: From 3050 on. Clan schemes are more aggressive, use animal patterns more often and are kept uniform per Star (five ’Mechs).

categories.name: Mercenaries
categories.description: Mercenaries have no prescribed colours – that is the invitation to invent your own scheme. The well-known units work as templates.

categories.name: Periphery
categories.description: Small states, pirates and special cases. The freest in colour, because the least canonised.

factions.name: Federated Suns
factions.subtitle: House Davion
factions.description: Sun and sword. The parade colours are gold and black, often with a red accent – rich, courtly, a little arrogant. Of all the Great Houses, Davion has the widest spread between regiments.
factions.subunits: Davion Guards: gold with red · Crucis Lancers: green · Deneb Light Cavalry: dark blue · Avalon Hussars: sand brown
factions.paintSequence: Grey primer → Zandri Dust → Averland Sunset → Yriel Yellow (edges). Wash only into the recesses.
factions.tip: Yellow covers badly. Never over black – always build it up over bone or light grey.

factions.name: Lyran Commonwealth
factions.subtitle: House Steiner
factions.description: The armoured fist. Strong blue with white panels, plus lots of bare metal – Lyrans drive heavy and want you to see it.
factions.subunits: Lyran Guards: blue/white · Royal Guards: blue with gold · many border regiments in winter or greyscale camouflage
factions.paintSequence: Kantor Blue → Macragge Blue → edge highlight Fenrisian Grey. Metal: Leadbelcher + Nuln Oil.
factions.tip: Blue over black primer goes dull. Mid grey is the better base.

factions.name: Draconis Combine
factions.subtitle: House Kurita
factions.description: The Dragon. Red, black and white with gold edges, preferably in strict blocks rather than soft transitions. The most disciplined sense of colour in the Inner Sphere.
factions.subunits: Sword of Light: red/white with gold · Genyosha: dark green · Ghost Regiments: black and grey, deliberately plain
factions.paintSequence: Mephiston Red → Evil Sunz Scarlet → Wazdakka Red in the recesses. Gold sparingly: edges and trim only.
factions.tip: Red needs 2–3 thin coats. One thick coat drowns every detail.

factions.name: Free Worlds League
factions.subtitle: House Marik
factions.description: The Eagle. Purple with gold – the most striking palette in the game and the most rewarding if you like contrast. Politically the League is a patchwork, and so are its colours.
factions.subunits: Marik Militia: purple/gold · Regulan, Andurien and Oriente each fly their own house colours – freedom is allowed here
factions.paintSequence: Naggaroth Night → Xereus Purple → Genestealer Purple. Gold: Balthasar Gold + Retributor Armour on the edges.
factions.tip: Purple over black turns muddy. Prime grey, then lighten.

factions.name: Capellan Confederation
factions.subtitle: House Liao
factions.description: Jade green with black panels and red trim. The Confederation is the poorest of the great powers – worn, patched-up ’Mechs fit the theme perfectly.
factions.subunits: Death Commandos: black with red, no insignia · the Warrior Houses (Imarra, Kamata, Hiritsu …) each have their own colours
factions.paintSequence: Caliban Green → Warpstone Glow drybrush → Biel-Tan Green into the recesses.
factions.tip: Green quickly looks flat. A touch of yellow in the edge highlight brings it to life.

factions.name: ComStar
factions.subtitle: Com Guards
factions.description: Priestly white with gold trim bands. Looks spectacular on the table and is at the same time the hardest scheme for beginners.
factions.subunits: Com Guards: white/gold, division numbers painted large · ROM (intelligence): dark grey to black
factions.paintSequence: Prime grey → Apothecary White (Contrast) or Ulthuan Grey → White Scar only on the topmost edges.
factions.tip: Never paint white flat straight from the pot. A zenithal prime does half the work.

factions.name: Word of Blake
factions.subtitle: Splinter of ComStar
factions.description: The same white, but cold and military instead of ceremonial: dark panels, hard edges, red markings. The villain look of the Jihad era.
factions.subunits: Militia divisions with numbered shoulder plates · Manei Domini: black with white markings
factions.paintSequence: Grey Seer → Basilicanum Grey into the recesses → pick out panels in Eshin Grey.

factions.name: Free Rasalhague Republic
factions.subtitle: Rasalhague
factions.description: Scandinavian clarity: blue and white with a gold crest. Small, defiant, and from 3050 on right in the Clans’ flight path.
factions.subunits: Tyr, Freemen and the Kungsarmé units stick closely to blue/white
factions.paintSequence: Like Steiner, just a shade lighter and with more white.

factions.name: Federated Commonwealth
factions.subtitle: Davion + Steiner
factions.description: The alliance cast in colour: blue and gold side by side, sunburst and fist in the same crest. Handy if you can’t decide between two Houses.
factions.subunits: Mixed units often wear one half per House – fist on the left shoulder, sun on the right

factions.name: Clan Wolf
factions.subtitle: Invading Clan
factions.description: Sober dark grey, black panels, red markings. The most pragmatic Clan – and the scheme that looks most like a war machine rather than a parade.
factions.subunits: Wolf-in-Exile later adds more grey and white markings
factions.paintSequence: Mechanicus Standard Grey → Dawnstone drybrush → Nuln Oil. Red only on cooling fins and weapons.

factions.name: Clan Jade Falcon
factions.subtitle: Invading Clan
factions.description: The best-known Clan scheme of all: cool jade with sharp yellow flashes. Keep the green cold and let the yellow scream – a thin yellow stripe along the torso edge is enough.
factions.subunits: Falcon Guards and Turkina Keshik use more black
factions.paintSequence: Caliban Green → Warpstone Glow → mask the yellow stripes with tape, then Averland Sunset + Yriel Yellow.

factions.name: Clan Ghost Bear
factions.subtitle: Invading Clan
factions.description: Polar scheme: almost white with dark blue panels. Ponderous, patient, extremely elegant on the table – especially with snow bases.
factions.subunits: From 3060 on, as the Rasalhague Dominion, often combined with blue-and-gold Rasalhague elements
factions.paintSequence: Zenithal grey/white → Gryph-charger Grey thinly over everything → panels in Kantor Blue.

factions.name: Clan Smoke Jaguar
factions.subtitle: Invading Clan
factions.description: Big-cat pelt as armour: sandy olive with yellow-and-black rosettes. The most brutal Clan of the invasion and the most elaborate pattern – but a few spots on shoulder and thigh already do the job.
factions.subunits: Garrison Clusters are often plainer, just dark grey with a yellow emblem
factions.paintSequence: Zandri Dust base → irregular yellow ovals → a black ring around each with your finest brush.

factions.name: Clan Nova Cat
factions.subtitle: Invading Clan
factions.description: Light spotted pelt with turquoise trim lines. Mystics and visionaries – the warmest Clan scheme in colour.

factions.name: Clan Steel Viper
factions.subtitle: Invading Clan
factions.description: Green with gold scale patterns. If you fancy freehand, paint real scales – if not, put gold bands on the arm and leg armour.

factions.name: Clan Diamond Shark
factions.subtitle: later Clan Sea Fox
factions.description: Shark logic: dark blue-grey on top, light white underneath. A merchant Clan – well-kept, almost civilian-looking ’Mechs.

factions.name: Clan Hell's Horses
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Earthy rust orange with black panels. Combined arms, lots of infantry and tanks – ideal if you want to field mixed forces.

factions.name: Clan Snow Raven
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Only two colours, maximum contrast: white torso, black limbs and markings. Quick to paint, very effective.

factions.name: Clan Blood Spirit
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Deep red with black, isolationist and plain.

factions.name: Clan Fire Mandrill
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Orange to yellow – every Kindraa with its own variant.

factions.name: Clan Ice Hellion
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Light blue and white, fast light ’Mechs.

factions.name: Clan Star Adder
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Grey with yellow-and-black hazard stripes.

factions.name: Clan Coyote
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Earth brown and sand tones.

factions.name: Clan Cloud Cobra
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: White and sky blue, religiously influenced.

factions.name: Clan Goliath Scorpion
factions.subtitle: Home Clan
factions.description: Desert sand with dark armour plates.

factions.name: Clan Widowmaker
factions.subtitle: annihilated
factions.description: Black with a red hourglass – long since annihilated.

factions.name: Wolf's Dragoons
factions.subtitle: Mercenaries
factions.description: Black with grey panels, plus an accent colour per regiment (Alpha to Zeta). That way you can tell several lances apart without changing the scheme.

factions.name: Kell Hounds
factions.subtitle: Mercenaries
factions.description: Black with red and white markings. Closely tied to Steiner – elitist and deliberately sombre.

factions.name: Gray Death Legion
factions.subtitle: Mercenaries
factions.description: Grey on grey, a skull as the emblem. The perfect practice scheme: mistakes forgive themselves, and weathering looks good right away.

factions.name: Eridani Light Horse
factions.subtitle: Mercenaries
factions.description: Military olive and sand, descendants of the Star League. If you want to try real camouflage patterns, this is the faction for it.

factions.name: Northwind Highlanders
factions.subtitle: Mercenaries
factions.description: Scottish regiments in space – with real tartan patterns on the torso armour. Two crossed lines in red and yellow across the chest plate, and the plaid effect is done.

factions.name: Taurian Concordat
factions.subtitle: Periphery
factions.description: Maroon and grey, defensive and proud.

factions.name: Magistracy of Canopus
factions.subtitle: Periphery
factions.description: Purple and gold, openly decadent.

factions.name: Marian Hegemony
factions.subtitle: Periphery
factions.description: Roman red and brass, eagles and legion numbers.

factions.name: Outworlds Alliance
factions.subtitle: Periphery
factions.description: Forest green and brown, sparsely equipped.

factions.name: Aurigan Coalition
factions.subtitle: Periphery
factions.description: Teal and orange – from the HBS video game.

factions.name: Piraten
factions.subtitle: Periphery
factions.description: Repainted salvage: old schemes shimmer through.
